title: We use cookies
intro: Essential cookies keep the site running. With your consent we’d also use analytics and marketing cookies to improve our service. You can change your choice anytime.
preferencesDescription: Choose which categories of cookies to allow. You can change this later from the privacy policy page.
necessaryDescription: Required for the site to function (login, security, payment processing). Always on.
analyticsDescription: Helps us understand how the site is used so we can improve it. No personal data is sold.
marketingDescription: Used to show relevant content and measure campaign performance.
